title: CRUD API with OpenAPI and Postgres
description: A typed CRUD API whose Zod schemas validate requests and generate OpenAPI 3.1 docs with Swagger UI, backed by Lakebase Postgres.

environment.name: BOOKMARKS_API_TOKEN
environment.description: Random token (at least 32 characters, for example from openssl rand -hex 32) that callers send as Authorization: Bearer <token> on POST, PATCH, and DELETE. Required because Neon Function URLs are public.
